title: Pan-Seared Hake with Yeast Crust
description: A twist on the traditional German dish, this recipe features pan-seared hake with a crispy yeast crust. The yeast adds a unique flavor and texture to the dish.
instructions: Season the hake fillets with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the yeast, 1/4 cup warm water, and 1 tsp sugar.
Dust the hake fillets with flour, shaking off excess.
Pan-fry the hake fillets in butter until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer the hake to a baking dish and top with the yeast mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until the yeast crust is golden brown.
